KILL Proposal 3. KILL Proposal 6. Polynomial-calculus infeasibility does not imply the required quantitative CVP distance bound or controlled coefficient norm over unrestricted integer vectors. Generic degree O(log L) Macaulay systems can have quasipolynomial rank, and degree 1-4 behavior on one splice cannot resolve logarithmic scaling.
